content: We have carbon NMR shifts list. Need number of methyl (CH3) groups. Methyl carbons typically around 10-30 ppm (alkyl). In list: 14.05, 18.60, 22.65, 27.60, 28.70, 31.31. That's six signals in that region. However some could be other carbons like methylene (CH2) also in 20-40. Need to determine methyl count. Could also use proton NMR to see methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
